# `aitbc node monitor`

Monitor activity for a specific node.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node monitor [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-id` | text | — | yes | The Node id. |
| `--realtime` | flag | `false` | no | Real-time monitoring |
| `--interval` | integer | `5` | no | Update interval in seconds |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node monitor --node-id <node_id>
```
